full_text:
Nicolas Hernandez Member ID: ■■■■■■■■■■

2011

Opioid use began at age ■ with a prescription of Tramadol 50mg from my Primary Care Physician. It
was prescribed for my diagnosed depression. I was also prescribed 0.25mg Alprazolam by this same
physician for my severe anxiety. ■■■■■■■■■■ entered pain management due to a very strange body
pain that nobody could figure out. ■■■■■■ was put on Oxycodone and Oxycontin. I began to experiment with
extra ones that ■■■■ had – also any other opioids or Benzodiazepines that ■■■■ was prescribed.

2013

I mainly kept to Tramadol, Hydrocodone, Oxycodone, etc. I started becoming addicted to Alprazolam
around the end of this year.

2014

Benzodiazepine use skyrocketed to 22mg of Alprazolam a day. This lasted for about 8 months and ended
in a Grand Mal seizure. It took about 6 months to even start feeling normal again.

2015

I discovered Fentanyl. I skipped Heroin and went from prescription pharmaceuticals to street Fentanyl.

2018

I could no longer get any more Fentanyl so I switched to Heroin for a couple years.

2020

I was able to locate a steady supply of street Fentanyl.

2024

The person I was doing business with passed away so I decided that I was done with the Fentanyl. I
entered a local Methadone program for a 3 – 4 months and ended up getting poisoned by it. I lost over 20
pounds. My cheek bones were showing. I began feeling ill all of the time so I decided to leave. I went
back on Heroin with a plan to transition to Suboxone.

2025

In July I made the decision to transition to Suboxone on my own since the local clinics were booked
weeks in advance. I attempted to attend intake at a clinic twice but was told there was a scheduling error
both times I showed up so I continued self medicating on Suboxone successfully.

CURRENT SITUATION

Due to extreme financial hardship lately, I couldn’t afford buying it off of the street so I have went to the
ER three times and they have provided me generous prescriptions of Suboxone.

I am currently on Suboxone 4mg/1mg strips once in the morning and once before bedtime – 8mg/2mg
total a day.

My main concern is my Benzodiazepine use. I am currently on Alprazolam (no prescription) 6mg a day,
3mg in the morning and 3mg at bedtime. I have been tirelessly searching for a physician to help me taper
off safely so I do not have another seizure. I have been on this dose for about two years now.

It is extremely frustrating. I have finally made the choice to get clean and it is very difficult to find a doctor
willing to help me. Benzodiazepine withdrawal could be fatal. I was told I would not survive another Grand
Mal seizure if I end up having one.

My insurance (Carelon) spoke very highly of this telehealth psychiatry practice. I look forward to my first
virtual appointment.
